papa-s-taco-mia.title: Play Papa's Taco Mia Online - Build Your Dream Taqueria
papa-s-taco-mia.description: Have you ever wanted to run your own taqueria? Well, now you can with Papa's Taco Mia! They have all the ingredients you could ever want - beef, chicken, onions, peppers, hard shell and soft shell tacos. You can make any kind of taco you desire. Join Papa's Taco Mia today and start crafting your dream tacos!

HomeIframe.title: Papa's Taco Mia™
HomeIframe.description: Build your dream taqueria with Papa's Taco Mia! Create delicious tacos with a variety of ingredients.

HomeFeatures.whatIsDescription: Papa's Taco Mia is a fun and interactive game where you can build your own taqueria and create delicious tacos with a variety of ingredients.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep1: Choose your ingredients from beef, chicken, onions, peppers, and more.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep2: Select your taco shell - hard or soft.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep3: Assemble your taco and serve it to your customers.
HomeFeatures.feature1Description: Choose from beef, chicken, onions, peppers, and more to create your perfect taco.
HomeFeatures.feature2Description: Select between hard shell and soft shell tacos for different textures.
HomeFeatures.feature3Description: Build your own taqueria and serve tacos to your customers.
HomeFeatures.feature4Description: Make any kind of taco you desire with endless combinations.
